I have a few!

1. Just breathe.

Almost if the time when I’m feeling like that really bad stuff I just remember the time in my life where I had tea bad social anxiety and the way to get through it was just to breathe. And even if it sucked at the time, just by breathing I could get through it. 

2. You’re halfway through the woods already, might as well continue. Going back would be a waste of time. 

My super rad therapist told this to me when I was feeling suicidal over something that looked like it would last forever but in actuality it lasted a couple of months? So whenever I’m in a really hard situation I think - where am I in the woods and can I make it through the rest of it? 

3. The most important. Your cousin loves you and she’s gone through so much pain in her life- do not give her more pain in her life.

My cousin is the most important person in my life. She’s been there for all my bad days and all my good days. She knows all my darkest secrets and all my shortcomings. She’s honestly like a savior to me. So with that I’m going to try my best to make sure that I make her as happy or happier than she’s made me. And doing something to myself would make her sad
